<a id="shape_parts"></a>
### [`shape_parts`](../../../../src/graphics/fighter_shapes_8000.asm#L6) `$8000-$803F`

*data*

Fighter part graphics, the same bytes as in v1. Part p (1-255) is the 64-byte block at shape_parts + p*64: page from $7f00, low byte from $38b0. Block 0 stays unused: part number 0 means an empty slot, and the shape builder never reads it. It holds 64 zero bytes.
